rev.t: Visited Cafe Amudham recently and had a mixed experience overall. The place looks clean, well maintained, and gives a good first impression when you walk in. The interiors are neat and organised, and you can feel that hygiene is taken …
The place feels well-maintained and gives you confidence about the quality and cleanliness right from the moment you walk in. …
For the first time in my life, I saw an item labelled GHEE lemon shavige. Why? Why?? What’s so wrong with humble shavige that it needs a ghee coating and cooked in a Wok!! …
